responsibilities: Develop analytical models and frameworks that explain why business performance moves, going beyond traditional variance analysis to identify structural drivers, second-order effects and long-term implications
Design, build and deploy automated and agent-driven analytical workflows that can query complex financial logic, perform contextual performance deep dives and run scenario simulations
Translate financial and strategic logic into scalable, reusable decision-support products rather than one-off analyses or presentations
Build intuitive interfaces and analytical tools that enable Finance stakeholders and senior management to access relevant insights efficiently
Continuously improve analytical products by tracking adoption, gathering user feedback and enhancing usability and functionality
Support the transformation of the wider Finance organisation towards an AI- and agent-enabled way of working
Act as a bridge between Finance, Business Intelligence, Data and Technology teams to ensure harmonised, scalable and interoperable solutions
Partner closely with Strategic Finance and senior leadership on questions related to business performance, portfolio management, capital allocation and long-term value creation
Help establish standards, architectures and best practices for using AI and automation within Finance

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Help establish standards, architectures and best practices for using AI and automation within Finance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: No speed or shipping language anywhere; the closing responsibility is to "establish standards, architectures and best practices", which is a rigour framing.
evidence.domain_risk: Partner closely with Strategic Finance and senior leadership on questions related to business performance, portfolio management, capital allocation and long-term value creation
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Output feeds "capital allocation" and portfolio decisions taken by senior leadership, so errors land directly on financial decisions.
evidence.collaboration_width: Finance; Business Intelligence; Data; Technology teams; Strategic Finance; senior leadership
evidence.data_team_maturity: help build the analytical and technical foundation that transforms Finance from a largely manual and retrospective function into an automated, agent-based decision intelligence organisation
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role exists to "build the analytical and technical foundation" for a Finance function described as "largely manual and retrospective", so the capability is being established rather than scaled.
evidence.jd_authorship: going beyond traditional variance analysis to identify structural drivers, second-order effects and long-term implications
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the actual analytical method — "beyond traditional variance analysis", "scenario simulations" — rather than generic stakeholder language.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build intuitive interfaces and analytical tools that enable Finance stakeholders and senior management to access relevant insights efficiently
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named audience throughout is Finance and senior management, down to "explaining a data model to a CFO".
evidence.autonomy_level: Help establish standards, architectures and best practices
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic verbs are consistently hedged with "help" and "support", sitting alongside build-and-deploy delivery work.
evidence.ai_role: Design, build and deploy automated and agent-driven analytical workflows that can query complex financial logic
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds the agent-driven workflows that consume financial data, so AI sits downstream of their output.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Neither testing, data contracts, observability nor data quality appears in responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely as capability-building and transformation, with no mention of risk, audit or the cost of bad data.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: help build the analytical and technical foundation
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Infrastructure verbs are build/design/establish against a function that does not yet have this capability.
